title: ADR-0131 D9 on a walled control plane: three framework writers land NULL organization_id rows on every sign-up (the self-registration grant, the verification mail, activity about org-less records)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#1979 measurement round (PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3021), out-of-scope finding 1: class b, Seam spec → runtime. objectstack-ai/cloud#1979's acceptance line 「zero NULL rows on the control plane」 cannot close while these writers run, and they are all framework code. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Contract (ADR-0131, `docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md`)

- **D9:** a write on a tenant-column object with no organization is derived under `single` (the Default Organization is the only one) and refused otherwise.
- **D7 / D3:** an object whose writer attributes rows to an organization is tenant data and keeps the column, NOT NULL.

## What was measured (framework pin `be076dad28a0`, a fresh control plane, `isolated`)

`signup-org-flow`'s own boot and journey (17/17), then a census of the sqlite store. 98 tables, 50 with an organization column, and 46 of those hold no NULL. Cloud-written rows are all labelled. NULL `organization_id`:

| table | NULL / total | writer | what the rows are |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `sys_user_permission_set` | 2 / 3 | plugin-auth `auth-manager.ts` `settleSelfRegistrationGrant` ("falls back to an unscoped row only when no org is resolvable") | each self-registrant's `cloud_control_plane_member` grant |
| `sys_email` | 3 / 6 | plugin-auth's verification-mail persistence | the verification mails (`related_object` `sys_user`); the 3 labelled rows are the invitations |
| `sys_activity` (shard `sys_activity__r20261018`) | 27 / 40 | plugin-audit's activity writer | activity about records with no organization: `sys_user` ×12, the NULL `sys_email` ×6, the 2 NULL grants, `sys_organization`, `sys_platform_setting`, `sys_setting_audit`, `sys_jwks`, `sys_oauth_resource`, `sys_verification`, `sys_team_member` |

- These are runtime writes on every sign-up (`POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email` and the verification send), not migration residue.
- **The ceremony does not catch them.** `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts` counts unattributable rows (fate 4) as `advisory`, "never held against the verdict". `organization-ownership.ts:774` sets `verified_at` from `complete && blocking === 0`. So a control plane reads `applied=t verified=t blocking=0` with these rows present. ADR-0131 C3's ruling reads the gate as satisfied only when the remaining NULL rows are the sharing-rule mirrors.
- `sys_audit_log.tenant_id` also reads NULL on 35 / 48 rows, but that is D7's attribution field, not the anchor, so it is not counted here.

## Wanted

For each of the three writers, the shape D9 and D7 already rule: the row gets an organization the writer can derive (the registrant's organization once it exists, the record's organization for activity), or the object leaves the tenant-column set (no column, D7). A writer with neither is refused, not let through as NULL. Which fate fits each table is the engine and services lanes' call.

## Acceptance

- The same census on a fresh control plane after a sign-up reads 0 NULL `organization_id` rows on these three tables, or the table carries no column.
- The ceremony's `advisory` count for them reads 0, with a test.

## Dedupe

500 objectstack issues (open and closed, by last update) scanned for `settleSelfRegistrationGrant`, NULL `organization_id` with a runtime writer, and `resolveSystemInsertOrganization`: none carries these writers. objectstack-ai/objectstack#24314 (injected columns on a better-auth table) is a different defect: nothing extends `sys_organization` on main, so it does not reach this line.
